subject: VistaEdge: Architecture & Control Evidence Request
messages:
From: Alice Hunt <alice.hunt@vistaedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: architecture controls & evidence for SOC 2 / ISO mapping

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — VistaEdge is moving quickly on the procurement side. Our InfoSec team is collecting product-level artifacts to complete our vendor risk assessment. We need the following by EOD Friday (2027-11-05):

- Control crosswalk mapping to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 (control IDs + short mapping notes)
- Latest SOC 2 report or bridge letter (PDF)
- High-level production network diagram and encryption at-rest/in-transit notes
- Any compensating/control design notes for external access and key management

Can you confirm you can share these under an NDA? If helpful, I attached a short intake template.

Attachments: vista_request_summary.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Alice Hunt
Senior Information Security Analyst
VistaEdge Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Hunt <alice.hunt@vistaedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: architecture controls & evidence for SOC 2 / ISO mapping

Hi Alice — appreciate the clear list. We can absolutely assemble this and share under NDA.

Quick plan:
1) I’ll kick off an internal evidence sprint and loop in Marissa (Security PM) and Karthik (Controls/Compliance).
2) We’ll produce a control_crosswalk CSV and attach our most recent SOC 2 report.
3) We’ll include a redacted production network diagram and a short KMS/key-management note.

Can you confirm the NDA point of contact? If you can send the DocuSign link we’ll route for review.

Proposed delivery: 2027-11-02 EOD for an initial packet (we can add additional artifacts afterwards).

Best,
Ben Carter | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T18:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: architecture controls & evidence for SOC 2 / ISO mapping

Ben — adding a short checklist and owners. I started the control_crosswalk (attached).

Action items:
- Karthik: Pull the SOC 2 report (2026) and confirm any open exceptions; attach the PDF and a brief cover note.
- Karthik: Produce a 1-page KMS/key-management summary (kms_note.md) and list key custodians.
- Infra: Export redacted prod network diagram (remove IPs and internal hostnames).
- Ben: Share DocuSign NDA link once VistaEdge provides it.

I’m tagging Jordan for quick approval to share the SOC 2 PDF and network diagram with a third party under NDA.

Attachments: control_crosswalk_vistaedge.csv (text/csv)

Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T19:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: architecture controls & evidence for SOC 2 / ISO mapping

Marissa / Ben — I pulled the following artifacts and started packaging them into a single bundle. See list below and ETA.

Artifacts prepared for VistaEdge:
- redwood_soc2_2026_report.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, auditor: NorthPoint LLP)
- prod_network_diagram_redacted.pdf (redacted topology, shows VPC peering, NAT/egress paths)
- kms_summary.txt (key rotation cadence, KMS provider, HSM notes)
- control_crosswalk_vistaedge.csv (Marissa’s starter file, I added mapping notes)
- artifact_bundle_vistaedge.zip (zipped package with the above)

Open item: we have a legacy dev-only exception documenting ephemeral test keys for an internal CI system (CI-KEY-EXC). I recommend including a compensating control note describing strict lab access and automatic key rotation; we should call this out explicitly in the cover note.

ETA: I can deliver the zip to Ben by 2027-11-02 14:00Z for review.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference

Ben/Marissa — approve sharing the SOC 2 report and the redacted network diagram under a standard mutual NDA. Two notes:
1) Redact any internal hostnames and full IP addresses.
2) Exclude vendor-specific throughput numbers that are commercial-sensitive (we can share ranges).

If you need legal to sign any exceptions, loop in legal. Proceed on Ben’s timeline.

Jordan Blake
VP, Sales Operations (acting as exec approver)
